guitar.evidence: Jackson 5 used Motown session musicians for guitar parts (no consistent named guitarist/gear); the group itself was vocal-led.

tone.target: bright clean funk-pop rhythm with short spring room
tone.profile: bright clean funk-pop rhythm with short spring room
tone.summary: A punchy, bright funk-pop rhythm tone achieved with a Comp boost for attack, followed by a US Deluxe amp model, paired with a Chorus (used sparingly) and Spring reverb for the required glassy high end and room feel.
